$comment: The listings indices on Meilisearch (provider `meilisearch`): the index settings of listings_en / listings_fr, rendered by ca.northline.searchindex.MeilisearchLayout with stopwords-<lang>.txt, synonyms-<lang>.txt (the same files as Elasticsearch) and the language's locale. Documents are ListingDocument plus the fields MeilisearchDocuments derives (_geo, openSlots, pausedUntilEpoch, priceBucket, categoryFacet, merchantFacet, suggestWeight, categorySuggest, hasLocation). Every setting here is applied in place by the bootstrap Job (Meilisearch re-indexes by itself); a change to the derived fields needs a reindex and a 'schema' bump. What Meilisearch does differently from Elasticsearch: docs/DECISIONS.md (Meilisearch search provider) and docs/runbooks/search.md § Meilisearch.
